subject: math

objective.text: Bundle ones into tens, tens into hundreds, and hundreds into 1 thousand. Then count the units.

source_ref.section: Objective

explanations.title: Bundle 10 ones to make 1 ten
explanations.text: Let's count lots of straws fast. Count 10 straws and bundle them. 10 ones make 1 ten. Counting by tens is faster than counting by ones.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (counting the straws efficiently)

explanations.title: 10 tens make 1 hundred
explanations.text: 10 tens make 1 hundred. Count the tens: 1 ten, 2 tens, and so on up to 10 tens. Now count the straws: 10, 20, 30, up to 100. 10 tens is 100 straws.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (bundling 10 tens)

explanations.title: The pattern: 10 of a unit make the next unit
explanations.text: Look at the pattern. 10 ones make 1 ten. 10 tens make 1 hundred. 10 hundreds make 1 thousand. 10 of a smaller unit make 1 of the next unit.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (how many hundreds make 1 thousand)

explanations.title: Make ten to build the next unit
explanations.text: Use a make-ten idea to build a new unit. 3 ones plus 7 ones make 10 ones, or 1 ten. 6 tens plus 4 tens make 10 tens, or 1 hundred. 2 hundreds plus 8 hundreds make 10 hundreds, or 1 thousand.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (make ten, make hundred, make thousand)

explanations.title: Draw and label the units
explanations.text: You can draw each unit and label it. Say the units from largest to smallest. 4 hundreds, 3 tens, and 5 ones is the number 435.

ext_skip_count_by_tens and ext_make_ten_partners are prerequisite cards that do not exist yet. The source never names them. Confirm they are the right prerequisites.
All 5 assets are not_available yet: a_meter_strip, a_clock_ribbon, a_straw_bundles, a_place_value_drawing, a_stickers_story. Items that use them cannot launch until they exist.

The source states no misconception, so the list is empty. Hint coverage is thin: 15 hints adapted from teacher moves, none for the zero in 308. All 5 explanations come from the straw-bundling and drawing approach in the source. There is no truly different alternative such as a number line.

visual_generation_rules: Diffusion cannot count reliably. Any picture where an exact number of objects matters must be built by code (SVG or widget) or drawn by an artist.
Diffusion is allowed only for: style or background art, and single icons (one ball, one pencil, one leaf, one character) that code then tiles to the exact count.
Every visual must be checked by a person: the count shown must equal the stimulus in the question and the rubric answer key.
Animations are described as frames with exact counts per frame, so they can be built or generated and then checked frame by frame.
Visual explanations are valid only when the asset exists (pipeline doc, Planner rules).
